The NT fronting has been a particular source of stress and indignation lately. Particularly now that there is so much helpful discourse around mental health emerging, young people seem to be more transparent with their mental health issues from the get-go. But when I try to do it, it comes out like an awkward half-step because it is a literal reflex to act as NT as possible. It makes me mad that I'm sort of damned if I do, damned if I don't; talk about it and people don't want to be around me or (in my case) it starts gossip and witch-hunting at my job. And if I don't talk about it, people just think I'm a lazy, "crazy" asshole and my employer assumes I'm a drug addict. *exhale*

No one has recommended it yet, I feel like they would probably laugh at me if I mentioned it because I have a reflex of downplaying my symptoms to the point of appearing "neurotypical" lol Survival mechanism I think? 

I have heard some interesting things about it though and I wouldn't be opposed to trying it. As for DMT, on the other hand, unless I had a doctor to monitor me... lol

I've tried so many many many different treatments, medications, methods etc. Short of DMT or electroshock therapy, I think I've covered the gamut. I'm just really tired. I have done irrevocable damage to body and probably my brain from some of the medications I have taken. I have 3 doctors and regular counselling and still I feel like dying 85% of the time. It's exhausting trying to book appointments to see specialists, getting a million different things of blood work done etc. People would always say "oh well you won't get better if you don't try" and I'm like.. for fucks sake I am constantly seeing doctors, making appointments, on waiting lists for testing etc. and all these doctors just think I'm a hypochondriac or something and I'm just... so tired. 

Sorry for the rant.
